title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Exhibition Hall on 1968-12-20

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard capture of a classic late‑1968 show, highlighted by Pigpen’s Turn On Your Lovelight and an acoustic jam on Mountains of the Moon.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that, despite a faint background hiss, delivers loud instruments and vocals that are generally clear and benefit from a little EQ. The performance is fondly remembered for Pigpen’s soulful Turn On Your Lovelight and Jerry’s acoustic guitar ending on Mountains of the Moon, with Phil’s bass work also noted as solid.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star praise for the show and its historic Pigpen moments; recording is soundboard with minor hiss, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Instruments and vocals are loud but a background hiss reduces clarity; reviewers note the tape sounds better than other copies and can be improved with EQ.

standout_songs: Mountains of the Moon (acoustic jam ending)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief, festival‑style set that captured the free‑wheeling spirit of late ’68, with Pigpen front and center and a memorable acoustic close.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Acoustic guitar jam at the end of Mountains of the Moon; fluid solo work up and down the neck, likely on his SG.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for playing Mountains of the Moon well.
